name: double_eq
prelude:
def double : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => double n + 2
statement: theorem double_eq (n : Nat) : double n = 2 * n
proofs:
induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp only [double, ih]; omega
  have double_add : ∀ m k, double (m + k) = double m + double k := by
    intro m k
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih => rw [← Nat.add_assoc, double, ih, double, Nat.add_assoc]
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [double_add k 1, ih]
    show 2 * k + 2 = 2 * (k + 1)
    rw [Nat.mul_succ]
